context: Wave 1 T6: hygiene batch A shipped — twining_commits gains hash validation (INVALID_INPUT on malformed) + 3-state commit_exists with disambiguating message via git cat-file; twining_discover default-excludes zero-overlap agents with excluded_zero_overlap count (min_score:0 restores roster); twining_record rejects empty summary with a repairable message and reason_rejected is now optional to match engine semantics.
rationale: the SDK validates zod at the transport layer, so a handler check works on every path (including direct invocation) and lets us control the repairable message and INVALID_INPUT code.
summary: Chose handler-level validation for record's empty-summary rejection over zod-only
